export const route = (a: number, b: readonly number[], c: boolean): number => {
  if (a > 0) {
    for (const x of b) {
      if ((x > 1 && c) || a > 2) {
        return c ? 1 : 2;
      } else if (c) {
        while (a > 0) {
          a -= 1;
        }
      } else {
        a += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return a;
};
